name: quicker-rpc-build-test
description: After quicker-rpc source changes, run pwsh ./build.ps1 -t (hot-reload plugin + qkrpc CLI/serve) without restarting agent-gui. Use when editing Plugin, Console, Contracts, AgentModel, build scripts, or RPC/CLI; when the user asks to build, test build, build -t, hot update, /hot-update, reload plugin, or restart qkrpc serve. For official getquicker release use quicker-rpc-publish + quicker-qkbuild-version-publish (third field +1).
